Name: Magic Greenhouse Garden
Author: Wandox99
Description:
Hello everyone!
This mod change the greenhouse's interior with a new map.
A "Magic" Garden with a lot of space, water and other 3 maps inside.
The maps are connect each other, they have all the greenhouse logic, so you can place your crops everywhere, add furniture and sprinklers if you want.
You can also fishing, I added a lot of fish to catch regardless of whether they are freshwater or saltwater fish: I don't know nothing of fish.
The fish change only in the BeachMap, on other maps this mod adds the same fish.
As you can see on the image, there are 4 maps in total, 2 normal and 2 really big.
I wanted to add some stumps on the farm, but for gamelogic, they respawn every time you restart your save, so I remove them.
The same logic is applied on trees: they regrowth every day, like the Cindersap Forest.

This mod mean to be used with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15442]Magic Greenhouse Gateway[/url], but it's not obligatory.


[size=5]Install[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.


[size=4]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]



If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url] with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels
